source.docs: The repository is the source of truth. This catalog points at it; it never duplicates a procedure.
source.versions: compatibility/version-matrix.md — parsed at build time, so a version bump propagates without touching this file.
source.adr: decisions/ADR-*.md — the reasoning behind every option below.

methods.title: Bare metal
methods.summary: Physical servers, direct disk for storage and etcd, full control of the PCIe and NUMA topology.
methods.bestFor: Ceph at scale, GPU inference, predictable IO latency, no hypervisor in the failure path.
requirements: IPMI or BMC access for out-of-band installation
Local SSD for etcd, dedicated NVMe for Ceph journal and OSD DB
RAID1 for the boot disk, or software RAID managed by the OS baseline

methods.title: Virtual machines
methods.summary: VMs on an existing hypervisor, with the caveats below.
methods.bestFor: Small sites, environments where hardware is not available, fast proof of concept.
requirements: Ceph OSD disks must be raw or SCSI-passthrough, never a shared virtual disk
etcd must sit on a local SSD with local vCPUs, not on shared storage
GPU workloads need passthrough; MIG is not virtualizable, so the whole card must be passed through
The hypervisor becomes part of the failure domain and must be in the DR plan

clusterMethods.title: Kubespray (Ansible)
clusterMethods.summary: Version-pinned inventory, idempotent, offline-capable, five releases supported in parallel.

options.title: Oracle Linux 8
options.warning: Kernel 4.18 is below the 4.19 recommendation in the Kubespray kernel matrix.

options.warning: Longer maintenance windows and a third failure domain needed to justify it.

OpenBao (MPL 2.0)

Istio

steps.title: Confirm the requirements, assumptions and open decisions
actions: Close every open decision D-01..D-14
Confirm the site IP plan and the failure domains
Confirm the legal position on the Vault license

steps.title: Read the architecture and the decisions
actions: Review the architecture overview
Review the failure-domain table for the components you selected

steps.title: Stand up the internal repositories and mirror every artifact
actions: Deploy Harbor and Nexus
Run the staging workflow for every component you selected
Verify offline package install, image pull and chart deploy on a throwaway node

steps.title: DNS, NTP, network, PKI, identity, load balancing
actions: Deploy DNS and NTP
Create the internal CA and distribute the trust bundle
Deploy the edge load balancer
Implement the firewall rules from the matrix

steps.title: Automation Management Server, Ansible, AWX, GitLab, Vault
actions: Install Ansible in a virtualenv with the pinned version
Deploy AWX and register the runners
Deploy Vault on dedicated hosts and test the unseal procedure

steps.title: Provision and harden the nodes
actions: Configure the internal repositories
Apply sysctl, kernel modules and the security baseline
Join the directory, if selected
Install the monitoring and logging agents

steps.title: Deploy the storage platform
actions: Create the CRUSH map with the host failure domain
Create the pools, the filesystem and the object store
Check Ceph HEALTH_OK before consuming any PVC

steps.title: Deploy the cluster with Kubespray
actions: Fill the inventory and the group vars
Mirror the artifacts for the selected Kubespray release
Run cluster.yml, then validate the control plane and etcd

steps.title: CNI, ingress, load balancing, CSI
actions: Install the CNI and confirm kube-proxy replacement
Configure MetalLB and the ingress controller
Configure the CSI driver and the StorageClasses
Apply the Gateway API CRDs

steps.title: Rancher, Keycloak, Argo CD, backup
actions: Install Rancher and register the Application Cluster
Wire Keycloak OIDC and verify the groups claim
Install Argo CD and sync the first application
Install Velero and run a first backup

steps.title: Vault integration, admission policy, runtime detection
actions: Bind the Vault role to the service account
Deploy the admission controllers in audit mode, then enforce
Enable the runtime detection ruleset
Verify certificate renewal and secret rotation

steps.title: Metrics, alerting, logs
actions: Install the monitoring stack and confirm every target is up
Configure the alert routes and the runbook links
Deploy the log pipeline and prove the redaction filter

steps.title: GPU workers, driver, sharing, serving
actions: Install the driver and the GPU Operator
Configure MIG and verify the isolation
Mirror the model weights and start the inference server
Validate the DCGM metrics

steps.title: Pipelines, approval gates, drift detection
actions: Wire the 14 pipeline stages
Protect the branches and require the approvals
Turn on the nightly drift job

steps.title: Upgrades, backups, restore, disaster recovery
actions: Run the upgrade procedure on a staging copy
Restore into a scratch namespace and measure the RTO
Rebuild a node from the OS and Kubespray
Exercise the full rebuild order offline

steps.title: Acceptance tests and handover
actions: Execute every acceptance test and store the evidence
Record the known limitations
Hand over to the operations team

upgradeSections.title: Before any upgrade
actions: Confirm the target version is in the version matrix
Confirm the compatibility constraints for the component
Mirror the target artifacts and pull-verify them
Take and verify a backup
Check the end-of-life watchlist for a forced exit

upgradeSections.title: Kubernetes and Kubespray
actions: One minor version at a time
Control plane first, then the workers
Run the target release's own virtualenv
Kubernetes has no rollback: the restore path is the backup

upgradeSections.title: Ceph and Rook-Ceph
actions: Rook operator first, then Ceph, then the CSI driver
The Rook release constrains the Ceph version
Ceph has no rollback across a major version

upgradeSections.title: Helm 3 to Helm 4
actions: Helm 3 security fixes end 2027-02-10
Install Helm 4 alongside Helm 3
Re-run every chart operation under Helm 4
Keep the Helm 3 binary until the date passes

upgradeSections.title: Edge load balancer
actions: Update the image tags in the Compose file
Upgrade one node, verify, then the other
Confirm the VRRP state and the health checks after each node

upgradeSections.title: GPU operator, driver and CUDA
actions: Drain one GPU node at a time
Verify the driver, the toolkit and the operator versions line up
Run nvidia-smi on the node and in a pod before uncordoning

upgradeSections.title: Ingress controller portfolio
actions: Check the deprecation stage of each controller
Upstream retirement forces Deprecated immediately
Migrate the traffic share before removing a controller

upgradeSections.title: Vault and the PKI
actions: Snapshot the raft storage before the upgrade
Upgrade the standby, then the active
Verify the unseal procedure and the audit device after the upgrade
